intro: Our Sienna unit helps you make the most of your space. Thoughtful storage, hidden wire management, and a sleek two-tone finish create a clean, organised entertainment setup that fits right in.

features.title: Perfect for compact spaces
features.text: Designed to fit in smaller rooms, our unit offers smart storage without taking up too much space—perfect for modern apartments and cosy setups.

features.title: Wire management for a clean setup
features.text: Messy cables can ruin a great space. Built-in wire management keeps cords hidden, so your entertainment area always looks neat and organised.

features.title: Push-to-open mechanism for effortless access
features.text: No bulky handles—just a simple push to access storage compartments, keeping the design sleek and clutter-free.

features.title: Versatile storage for all your essentials
features.text: Use the surface for a TV, books, or décor, while the storage compartments keep remotes, accessories, and other must-haves neatly tucked away.

features.title: Dual-tone finish for a modern touch
features.text: A warm wood and grey finish adds a stylish contrast, making this unit a seamless fit for any living space.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
